messages:
jamie_ops: P1 alert — several customers reporting 5xx / timeouts on hosted inference (POST /v1/generate). Spike started ~02:12 UTC, p50 latency jumped from 120ms -> 2.3s and 5xx rate ~8%. Visible in edge gateway + inference runtime. Adding warroom.
ops_bot: Incident created: #P1-inference-5xx (auto-assigned). Pager duty notified.
sarah_oncall: Acknowledged. Can someone grab the immediate mitigation checklist from the runbook? Need quick steps to reduce customer impact. :eyes:
leo_infra: On it. First things: 1) Check autoscaler for Dedicated pools, 2) disable non-critical batching changes, 3) enable fallback routing to smaller model variant. I can flip routing to model-v1-small as short-term.
maya_support: Customer X (acct id 98321) just opened escalation — seeing request timeouts and a few 502s. They're on Hosted EU region. They're asking for ETA. I pushed initial note saying we're investigating.
dave_eng: On logs: seeing repeated gateway 502s with grpc errors to runtime: "context deadline exceeded" and repeated connection resets. Might be a cold-start/kvcache stall pattern. Attaching quick repro curl we used: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"model-v1","input":"test"}'```
sarah_oncall: Good repro. Leo, can you run a target scale up for eu-hosted pool and route a fraction (10-20%) to model-v1-small as failover? That should reduce latency and 5xx for affected customers.
leo_infra: Scaling up nodes now (requested +3 gpus to eu-hosted pool). Routing rule updated: /v1/generate -> model-v1-small for 15% of traffic from EU region. Monitoring.
ops_bot: Autoscaler event: +3 instances requested (eu-hosted-pool).
jamie_ops: Quick comms: @maya_support please tell Customer X we expect partial mitigation in ~6-8 mins, full stabilization after scale completes (~15 mins). Use template: "We're scaling capacity and enabling a temporary fallback; we'll update within 15 minutes."
maya_support: Sending now. Also asking whether RLHF quantization changes were rolled last night? Could break performance.
dave_eng: There was a canary deploy of runtime optimization at 00:50 UTC with KV-cache tweak. Canary passed for 1h but I see more errors post 02:10. Rolling back the canary on one lane to test.
leo_infra: Rollback started for canary lane infra-3. If rollback reduces 5xx we'll keep it rolled back and then iterate on fixes.
sarah_oncall: Adding immediate action items: 1) scale eu pool (+leo_infra) 2) maintain 15% fallback routing (+leo_infra) 3) rollback recent KV-cache canary (+dave_eng) 4) customer comms (+maya_support) 5) collect traces/slow-requests for last 30m (+jamie_ops).
tina_pm: I'll prepare a short status update for impacted customers and Sales.
jamie_ops: Also assign postmortem owners: dave_eng (root cause analysis), leo_infra (scaling/autoscaler tuning), sarah_oncall (runbook gaps + SLA notes), maya_support (customer comms timeline). We'll run a follow-up meeting in 24h to confirm action items.
ops_bot: Severity updated: P1 -> mitigation in progress.
leo_infra: Scale complete, fallback routing steady at 15%. 5xx rate dropping to 2% and p90 latency improving.
dave_eng: KV-cache canary rollback applied to all lanes at 02:28 UTC. Early signs show reduced grpc timeouts on runtime.
sarah_oncall: Closing loop for warroom: mitigation successful, still tracking for 1h to confirm stability. Next: postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow.
jamie_ops: Note for postmortem: include timeline, canary rollout details, autoscaler behaviour, recommended runbook patch (auto-fallback when 5xx>5% for 10m), and customer comms timeline.
maya_support: Customer X updated — grateful for quick response. Keeping thread for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
